name: Introduction to bonding ionic and covalent

questions.q: Why do atoms form chemical bonds with other atoms?
a: To achieve a stable, full outer electron shell (like a noble gas)

questions.q: If an atom has 7 valence electrons (like chlorine), what does it typically do to achieve stability?
a: Gain 1 electron or share 1 electron pair to complete its octet
